approval.ownerWords: Of course. And change the rule from limit to buffer that produces a notice but not a halt

scope: Valid static compressed-size exceedances produce a visible NOTICE, not a release halt. No further per-version small-size exception is required. Measurement integrity, candidate/content binding, request counts and all other performance, functional, security and data gates remain hard.
history: The exact 606 exception and its refusal tests remain historical evidence, not the active ordinary size policy.
